note: Client-side directory only. Aliases are common statement strings, not a charge lookup.

items.name: Amazon Prime
items.feeNote: No cancel fee · refund window is short
items.hint: Then End membership.

items.name: Amazon Music
items.feeNote: Unlimited is a separate bill from Prime
items.hint: Cancel under Subscription Renewal. Prime music dies only with Prime.

items.name: Netflix
items.feeNote: Deleting the app does not cancel
items.hint: Finish Cancellation. Billed by a partner? Use Apple or Play.

items.name: Disney Plus
items.feeNote: Web cancel · bundles keep billing
items.hint: Profile, Account, Cancel Subscription. Partner billed? Apple or Play.

items.name: Hulu
items.feeNote: Pause is not cancel
items.hint: Cancel, then Continue to Cancel. Next Charge means it is still live.

items.name: Max
items.feeNote: Max and HBO Max are the same bill
items.hint: No Cancel button means a partner owns the receipt.

items.name: Paramount Plus
items.feeNote: TV app often cannot cancel
items.hint: Cancel subscription. Carrier and store bills hide the button.

items.name: Peacock
items.feeNote: No pause · unused days often stay billed
items.hint: Plans and Payments, then Cancel Plan.

items.name: Apple TV Plus
items.feeNote: The TV app cannot cancel
items.hint: Settings, your name, Subscriptions.

items.name: Spotify Premium
items.feeNote: Often web only · partner plans hide Cancel
items.hint: Cancel Premium. Family members cannot kill the manager's bill.

items.name: YouTube Premium
items.feeNote: YouTube, Play, or Apple. Match the receipt
items.hint: iOS signup dies in Settings.

items.name: X Premium
items.feeNote: Cancel on the platform you used · no refund for time paid
items.hint: Web to Premium to Manage. Apple or Play receipt? Cancel there.

items.name: Adobe Creative Cloud
items.feeNote: Annual plans can charge a fee after day 14
items.hint: Manage plan, then Cancel your plan.

items.name: Microsoft 365
items.feeNote: Apps cannot cancel · storage drops after
items.hint: Cancel subscription. Copy OneDrive files out first.

items.name: Dropbox
items.feeNote: Cancel plan is a downgrade, not delete
items.hint: Cancel plan. Files above the free limit can lock.

items.name: ChatGPT Plus
items.feeNote: Chat window cannot cancel
items.hint: Apple or Play receipt? Cancel there.

items.name: Canva Pro
items.feeNote: App uninstall does not cancel · team members cannot
items.hint: Cancel plan. Apple or Play receipt? Cancel there.

items.name: Anything billed by Apple
items.feeNote: The app cannot cancel itself
items.hint: Phone: Settings, your name, Subscriptions. Try reportaproblem.apple.com before a bank fight.

items.name: Anything billed by Google Play
items.feeNote: The app is the wrong door
items.hint: Cancel in Play, not inside the app.

items.name: LinkedIn Premium
items.feeNote: No cancel fee · keep benefits until cycle ends
items.hint: Me, Premium features, Manage subscription, Cancel.

items.name: Audible
items.feeNote: App will not cancel · credits expire
items.hint: audible.com, Account details, Cancel membership. Finish every retention screen.

items.name: Planet Fitness
items.feeNote: Home club · letter or in person for most
items.hint: Try online first, then visit home club or certified mail. Notice by the 10th.

items.name: Norton
items.feeNote: Uninstall does not cancel · retention offers
items.hint: Cancel Subscription Renewal → Unsubscribe → No thanks, cancel.
